**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation"), deployed 02:12–02:14 UTC. It broke the gateway's connection pool — requests stopped releasing connections back to the pool. `in_use` locked at 20/20 and the `waiting` queue climbed without ever recovering, through the end of the log.

**Impact window:** 2026-03-14 02:14:18 UTC to at least 03:59:27 UTC (log ends there, still failing — not yet resolved as of the last line captured). First sign was a `WARN pool acquire slow` at 02:14:14, then the first 503 four seconds later.

**Error signature:**
```
ERROR access  req-XXXXX <path> -> <svc> 503 <duration>ms
ERROR pool    req-XXXXX ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)
```

**Scope:** Gateway only. Worker pool (separate, size 8) stayed healthy the whole window — jobs kept completing normally. No cross-service spread.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471` on gateway. No other deploy in the window is implicated — the two after it (`dep-4472` billing-svc, `dep-4473` catalog-svc) are unrelated services and started after the 503s were already underway.
